g.text: Base board for the Waveshare ESP32-P4-ETH / -POE-ETH: the module plugs in from above (header P1, Pico layout,

g.desc: Base board for the Waveshare ESP32-P4-ETH / -POE-ETH: the module plugs in from above (header P1, Pico layout,

g.text: rows 17.78 mm apart). J1 = P4 pins 1-20, J7 = P4 pins 21-40. +5V = VSYS (P4 pin 39). The PoE module sits on top of the P4.

g.desc: rows 17.78 mm apart). J1 = P4 pins 1-20, J7 = P4 pins 21-40. +5V = VSYS (P4 pin 39). The PoE module sits on top of the P4.

g.text: All parts through-hole. ESPHome: buttons GPIO22/20/21/23 INPUT_PULLUP, inverted (pressed = low); LEDs GPIO32/33/4/5 via LEDC (PWM).

g.desc: All parts through-hole. ESPHome: buttons GPIO22/20/21/23 INPUT_PULLUP, inverted (pressed = low); LEDs GPIO32/33/4/5 via LEDC (PWM).

g.text: Button connectors (JST-XH): 1 = LED+ (+5V), 2 = LED-, 3 = switch (NO), 4 = GND (switch C).
